I recently had the misfortune of staying at Vikas Paying Guest for 2 months, and I must say it was one of the worst experiences of my life. The facilities were subpar, with brick-like beds that made sleeping a nightmare. The kitchen was infested with cockroaches, making it impossible to cook a decent meal.

But what really took the cake was the maid, Rahul, who spoke to me in the most disrespectful manner. He behaved like he owned the place, and his attitude was completely unprofessional.

I paid rent for 2 months, but due to the unbearable conditions and disrespect, I was forced to leave within 1.5 months.
